description: Default capability for the main Bridge window + the floating companion overlay windows. Deliberately minimal: core only — the sensor_bridge commands are gated behind explicit user permission grants (deny OS permissions → Bridge still fully useful, per the graceful-degradation rule). overlay-1 through overlay-3 cover common multi-monitor setups (primary + up to 3 additional displays); users with > 4 monitors see the same core:default IPC on their extra displays.
